sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-When Unison Chance is in effect, Unison Assist (increases total stats based on the number of members using the same effect) will activate.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 15.
Unison gauge reduction boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fire, water, wind Unison damage Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces light, dark, time, and star Unison damage Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Applies Domination Collapse (nullifies the target's buffs, reduces the target's critical hit chance to zero, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by the target by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000

[Canonize] Fugue or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
